| §18.5 | **The peel bound in factorial-product form** (Issue #3954) | **Done (`peelBound ≤ (|V|·∏_v (childCount v)!)/(1−Δ²e|t|)^{2n+1}`)** | `ClusterExpansion/RootedParentActivePeelBoundFactorial.lean`. Bounding the root moment factor of the child-count peel bound by the root moment bound (#4127) and collecting the per-vertex `(1−r)` powers (`r = Δ²e|t|`) recasts the peel bound (full active set, exponent `0`) as a factorial product. `rootedParentActivePeelBound_univ_zero_le_card_mul_prod_childCount_factorial_div` (`0 < 1−Δ²e|t|`): `rootedParentActivePeelBound G par univ (fun _ => 0) t ≤ (|V|·∏_v (childCount v)!)/(1−Δ²e|t|)^{2n+1}`. Proof: the product of peel factors `∏_j (d_{succ j}!/(1−r)^{d_{succ j}+1})` collects (via `Finset.prod_div_distrib` + `Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum`) into `(∏_j d_{succ j}!)/(1−r)^{∑_j (d_{succ j}+1)}`; the root moment factor is bounded by #4127 (`≤ |V|·d_0!/(1−r)^{d_0+1}`); the per-vertex exponents sum to `2n+1` since the child counts sum to `n` (one parent-edge per non-root vertex) (`∑_v childCount v = n` via `Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise`, `Fin.sum_univ_succ`), and `∏_v d_v! = d_0!·∏_j d_{succ j}!` (`Fin.prod_univ_succ`). This is the form that pairs with the spanning-tree factorial bound `∑_T ∏_v (childCount v)! ≤ 4^n·n!` (#4126). Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.4–§18.5, pp. 332–336; Friedli–Velenik §5.4 (Theorem 5.4). |
| §18.5 | **The Penrose tree sum bounded by the (Δ²e|t|)^n-weighted peel bound** (Issue #3954) | **Done (tail of #4119)** | `ClusterExpansion/RootedParentActiveTreePeelBoundTail.lean`. The tail sharpening of `penroseTreeSum_le_sum_peelBound` (#4119): using the sharpened (tail) tree leaf-peel bound (#4130) at the final step. `penroseTreeSum_le_sum_pow_peelBound` (`Δ²e|t| < 1`): the Penrose tree-graph sum (the per-`(n+1)` weight of the Mayer-term bound #4095) is `≤ ∑_{T:ST(⊤)} (Δ²e|t|)^n · rootedParentActivePeelBound G (parentCode T) univ (fun _ => 0) t`. Identical to #4119 (Fubini swap #4118, root `e`-weight domination, `rootedParentActiveSum_univ_zero_eq` #4117) except the final per-`T` bound uses `rootedParentActiveSum_completeGraphTreeParentCode_univ_zero_le_pow_mul_peelBound` (#4130) instead of #4115, contributing the `(Δ²e|t|)^n` factor per shape. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.4–§18.5, pp. 332–336; Friedli–Velenik §5.4 (Theorem 5.4). |
| §18.5 | **The Mayer term bounded by the (Δ²e|t|)^n-weighted summed peel bound** (Issue #3954) | **Done (tail of #4120)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerTermPeelBoundTail.lean`. The tail sharpening of `mayerExpansionTerm_succ_abs_le_sum_peelBound` (#4120): composing the Penrose tree-graph bound on the Mayer term (#4095) with the tail Penrose tree-sum bound (`penroseTreeSum_le_sum_pow_peelBound`, #4132). `mayerExpansionTerm_succ_abs_le_sum_pow_peelBound` (`Δ²e|t| < 1`): `|mayerExpansionTerm G (n+1) t| ≤ (n+1)!⁻¹ · ∑_{T:ST(⊤)} (Δ²e|t|)^n · rootedParentActivePeelBound G (parentCode T) univ (fun _ => 0) t` (`mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left`, `(n+1)!⁻¹ ≥ 0`). The Mayer term is now bounded by the `(Δ²e|t|)^n`-weighted peel-bound sum; combining with the peel-bound factorial form (#4131) and the tree factorial bound (#4126) gives the summable geometric `(4r/(1−r)²)^n` bound. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.4–§18.5, pp. 332–336; Friedli–Velenik §5.4 (Theorem 5.4). |
| §18.5 | **★ Summability of the Mayer expansion terms (sufficient-condition KP convergence)** (Issue #3954) | **Done (absolute summability of `n ↦ \|mayerExpansionTerm G n t\|` under the sufficient condition `4r/(1−r)² < 1`)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerTermTailSummability.lean`. The convergence capstone, assembling the entire §18.5 KP machinery. `sum_pow_rootedParentActivePeelBound_le`: `∑_T (Δ²e|t|)^n·peelBound ≤ ((Δ²e|t|)^n·|V|·4^n·n!)/(1−Δ²e|t|)^{2n+1}` (the factorial-product peel bound #4131 summed over trees, with the tree factorial bound #4126 cast ℕ→ℝ via `Nat.cast_sum`/`Nat.cast_prod`, and `(1−r)`/`|V|` factored out by `Finset.mul_sum` + `mul_div_right_comm`). `mayerExpansionTerm_succ_abs_le_card_div_mul_geometric` (`Δ²e|t| < 1`): the geometric per-order bound `|mayerExpansionTerm G (n+1) t| ≤ |V|/(1−r)·(4r/(1−r)²)^n` (composing the tail Mayer bound #4133 with the summed peel bound, using `(n+1)!⁻¹·n! = n!/(n+1)! ≤ 1` and the power identity `(1−r)^{2n+1} = ((1−r)²)^n·(1−r)`, closed by `field_simp`/`ring`). `summable_abs_mayerExpansionTerm_succ_of_tail_condition` (`Δ²e|t| < 1` ∧ `4·Δ²e|t|/(1−Δ²e|t|)² < 1`): `Summable (fun n => |mayerExpansionTerm G (n+1) t|)`, via the geometric majorant `|V|/(1−r)·(4r/(1−r)²)^n` (`summable_geometric_of_lt_one` + `Summable.of_nonneg_of_le`). `summable_abs_mayerExpansionTerm_of_tail_condition`: the full series `n ↦ |mayerExpansionTerm G n t|` (including head terms) is summable (`summable_nat_add_iff`). This is a **sufficient-condition** high-temperature tail-summability result for the Mayer expansion terms on a fixed finite graph (a Kotecký–Preiss-type bound in the spirit of FV §5.4); it is not the sharp KP criterion, nor the convergence of the pressure/free-energy series, nor the thermodynamic limit. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.4–§18.5, pp. 332–336; Friedli–Velenik §5.4 (Theorem 5.4). |
| §18.5 | **Convergence of the Mayer expansion series** (Issue #3954) | **Done (Mayer partial sums converge in the explicit regime)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerSeriesConvergence.lean`. From the absolute summability of the Mayer expansion terms (#4134), under `4Δ²e|t|/(1−Δ²e|t|)² < 1`: `summable_mayerExpansionTerm_of_tail_condition`: `Summable (fun n => mayerExpansionTerm G n t)` (not merely absolutely; `Summable.of_abs`). `tendsto_mayerPartialSum_of_tail_condition`: `Tendsto (fun N => mayerPartialSum G N t) atTop (𝓝 (∑'_n mayerExpansionTerm G n t))` — the Mayer partial sums `∑_{n=0}^N mayerExpansionTerm G n t` converge to the Mayer series (`HasSum.tendsto_sum_nat` composed with `tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1` for the `range (N+1)` indexing). This discharges the "convergence follows from Kotecký–Preiss-type bounds (deferred)" note on `mayerPartialSum` in the explicit high-temperature regime. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.4–§18.5, pp. 332–336; Friedli–Velenik §5.4 (Theorem 5.4). |
| §18.5 | **Explicit bound on the Mayer expansion sum** (Issue #3954) | **Done (`∑'_n |mayerExpansionTerm G (n+1) t| ≤ |V|/((1−r)(1−ρ))`)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerTsumBound.lean`. Summing the geometric per-order bound (#4134) over `n`: `tsum_abs_mayerExpansionTerm_succ_le` (`Δ²e|t| < 1` ∧ `ρ := 4r/(1−r)² < 1`, `r = Δ²e|t|`): `∑'_n |mayerExpansionTerm G (n+1) t| ≤ |V|/(1−r)·(1−ρ)⁻¹` (`Summable.tsum_le_tsum` with the per-order bound + `tsum_mul_left` + `tsum_geometric_of_lt_one`). This is the explicit Kotecký–Preiss-type bound on the convergent cluster-expansion sum (the total contribution of the non-trivial Mayer orders), quantifying the term-summability of #4134. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.4–§18.5, pp. 332–336; Friedli–Velenik §5.4 (Theorem 5.4). |
| §18.5 | **Volume-uniform (per-site) Mayer expansion sum bound** (Issue #3954) | **Done (`(∑'_n |mayerExpansionTerm G (n+1) t|)/|V| ≤ ((1−r)(1−ρ))⁻¹`, volume-uniform RHS)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerTsumPerSite.lean`. Dividing the explicit Mayer expansion sum bound (#4136) by the volume `|V| = Fintype.card ι`: `tsum_abs_mayerExpansionTerm_succ_div_card_le` (nonempty `ι`, `Δ²e|t| < 1`, `ρ := 4r/(1−r)² < 1`, `r = Δ²e|t|`): `(∑'_n |mayerExpansionTerm G (n+1) t|)/|V| ≤ ((1−r)(1−ρ))⁻¹` (`div_le_iff₀` + the #4136 bound). The right-hand side is **independent of the volume**, and the Kotecký–Preiss condition `4Δ²e|t|/(1−Δ²e|t|)² < 1` itself depends only on the maximum degree `Δ` (volume-uniform on bounded-degree graphs) — so this is the volume-uniform convergence of the per-site cluster-expansion contribution, addressing the "volume-uniform convergence open" gap of the §18.5 convergence row via the KP tree-graph route. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.4–§18.5, pp. 332–336; Friedli–Velenik §5.4 (Theorem 5.4). |
| §18.6 | **Complex Mayer expansion term (holomorphic)** (Issue #4149) | **Done (complexification + per-term entire/analytic)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerCore/TermsComplex.lean`. The complex-analytic foundation for the per-site-KP Mayer–Montroll identity via analytic continuation (Issue #4149): complexifies the (real-polynomial-in-`t`) Mayer expansion term so it can be shown holomorphic. `clusterSeqActivityComplex z ω := ∏_{i:Fin n} z^{|ω i|}` and `mayerExpansionTermComplex G n z := ∑_ω (ursellCoefficient ω : ℂ)·clusterSeqActivityComplex z ω` (the `ursellCoefficient` is `t`-independent). `_ofReal` bridges `clusterSeqActivityComplex (↑t) ω = ↑(clusterSeqActivity t ω)` and `mayerExpansionTermComplex G n (↑t) = ↑(mayerExpansionTerm G n t)` (via `Complex.ofReal_{prod,pow,sum,mul}`). Each term is **entire**: `clusterSeqActivityComplex_differentiable` / `mayerExpansionTermComplex_differentiable` (`Differentiable ℂ`, finite product/sum of `z ↦ z^k`), hence `mayerExpansionTermComplex_analyticOnNhd` (`AnalyticOnNhd ℂ … Set.univ`, via `DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd`) and `mayerExpansionTermComplex_differentiableOn`. This is PR-A of the §18.6 analytic-continuation plan (next: the complex Mayer tsum holomorphic on a ball via `Complex.differentiableOn_tsum_of_summable_norm`, then the identity theorem on the per-site KP interval). Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.5–§18.6, pp. 335–340. |
| §18.6 | **Complex Mayer tsum holomorphic on a ball (Weierstrass)** (Issue #4149) | **Done (PR-B: `DifferentiableOn ℂ (∑'_n mayerExpansionTermComplex G n ·)` on `ball 0 R` under per-site KP at `R`)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerCore/TermsComplexHolomorphic.lean`. PR-B of the §18.6 plan: the complex Mayer series is holomorphic on the per-site Kotecký–Preiss ball, by a uniform summable majorant (Weierstrass M-test). **Norm bound** `mayerExpansionTermComplex_norm_le_termAbsSum`: `‖mayerExpansionTermComplex G n z‖ ≤ ∑_ω |ursellCoefficient ω|·clusterSeqActivity ‖z‖ ω` (`norm_sum_le` + `clusterSeqActivityComplex_norm`: `‖∏_i z^{|ω i|}‖ = ∏_i ‖z‖^{|ω i|}`) — the same term-absolute-sum that bounds `|mayerExpansionTerm G n ‖z‖|`. The geometric bound on it (`termAbsSum_le_treeSum_activity` extracting the per-`ω` `|ursell|·activity ≤ tree` step, then the existing `penroseTreeSum_le_sum_pow_peelBound` / `sum_pow_rootedParentActivePeelBound_le` chain reused) gives `mayerExpansionTermComplex_succ_norm_le_card_div_mul_geometric`: `‖mayerExpansionTermComplex G (n+1) z‖ ≤ (|ι|/(1−r))·(4r/(1−r)²)^n`, `r = Δ²e‖z‖`. With the majorant's monotonicity in `r` (`geometricMajorant_mono_of_le`) and the `n=0` head term (constant in `z`) added via `summable_nat_add_iff`, the **headline** `mayerExpansionTermComplex_tsum_differentiableOn_ball` (`0 ≤ R`, per-site KP at `R`): `DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∑'_n mayerExpansionTermComplex G n z) (Metric.ball 0 R)` (`Complex.differentiableOn_tsum_of_summable_norm`). Next (PR-C): `ofReal_tsum` + the identity theorem on `Ico 0 T'` give the volume-uniform real identity `polymerFreeEnergy = ∑'_n mayerExpansionTerm`. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.5–§18.6, pp. 335–340. |
| §18.5 / §18.6 | **Volume-uniform per-site Kotecký–Preiss Mayer–Montroll identity** (Issue #4149, capstone) | **Done (PR-C: `polymerFreeEnergy G t = ∑'_n mayerExpansionTerm G n t` on `Ico 0 T` for any per-site-KP `T`)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerCore/MayerIdentityPersiteKP.lean`. **The genuine upgrade of the Mayer–Montroll identity to the volume-uniform regime.** The existing `mayer_identity_general_t` holds only under the **volume-dependent** hypotheses `e·(total activity) < 1` / `|Ξ−1| < 1` (the naive `log(1+ε)` Taylor radius), which fail at large volume. Here the identity is extended to **any** per-site Kotecký–Preiss interval `Ico 0 T` — any `T > 0` satisfying the **volume-uniform** conditions `Δ²·e·T < 1` and `4r/(1−r)² < 1` (`r = Δ²eT`, equivalently `Δ²eT < 3−2√2`), which depend only on the maximum degree `Δ` — by **analytic continuation**: both sides are real-analytic on `Ico 0 T` and agree on a neighbourhood of `0` (`mayer_identity_general_t_eventually`), so they agree throughout by the identity theorem (`AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq`, `isPreconnected_Ico`). LHS analyticity is `polymerFreeEnergy_analyticOnNhd_Ici_zero` (`log Ξ`, `Ξ ≥ 1 > 0`); **RHS analyticity** `polymerFreeEnergy_analyticOnNhd_mayer_tsum_Ioo` / `_Ico`: the real Mayer tsum is `t ↦ (F ↑t).re` for the holomorphic complex tsum `F` (#4151), real-analytic by `AnalyticOnNhd.re_ofReal` (with `Complex.ofReal_tsum` + `mayerExpansionTermComplex_ofReal` identifying `↑(∑'_n mayerExpansionTerm) = F ↑t`). **Headline** `polymerFreeEnergy_eq_tsum_mayerExpansionTerm_of_persite_kp` (`0 < T`, per-site KP at `T`, `t ∈ Ico 0 T`). This closes the volume-dependence gap (Issue #4149) — the volume-uniform Mayer-series representation of the polymer free energy, the input for the §18.6 infinite-volume free-energy analyticity. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.5–§18.6, pp. 335–340; Friedli–Velenik §5.4. |
| §18.6 | **Volume-uniform per-site lattice free-energy bound** (Issue #4149) | **Done (PR-D1: `\|freeEnergy − (log2 + edge-density·log cosh)\| ≤ kpBound (2d)(tanh βJ)`, `Λ`-independent)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerCore/LatticeFreeEnergyKPBound.lean`. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.5–§18.6, pp. 335–340; Friedli–Velenik §5.4. |

The real-axis target for the §18.6 infinite-volume coupling analyticity (PR-D2.2+). Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.5–§18.6, pp. 335–340; Friedli–Velenik §5.4. |

| §18.6 | **Real-axis convergence of the cluster free energy** (Issue #4149) | **Done (PR-D2.3c: `F_n(↑t) → ↑(f_∞ t)` for `t ∈ Ioo 0 T`, `T ≤ 1`)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerCore/CubicMayerClusterRealAxis.lean`. Proof: the real per-site free energy `polymerFreeEnergy_n(t)/|Λ_n| = freeEnergy_n ⟨artanh t,0,1⟩ − log2 − (edge-density_n)·log cosh(artanh t)` (`freeEnergy_eq_polymerFreeEnergy`, `Real.tanh_artanh`) converges by the cubic free-energy limit (`freeEnergyAlongExhaustion_latticeGraph_cubicExhaustion_tendsto`) and the edge-density limit (#4154), then `Complex.continuous_ofReal`. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.5–§18.6, pp. 335–340; Friedli–Velenik §5.4. |
| §18.6 | **Whole-sequence Montel/Vitali limit of the cluster free energy** (Issue #4149) | **Done (PR-D2.3d, the crux: holomorphic `F_∞` with whole-sequence locally-uniform convergence)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerCore/CubicMayerClusterLimit.lean`. The Montel/Vitali capstone of the limit construction: the family `F_n` (#4156, holomorphic + ball-uniformly bounded, in a compact carrier #4157) converges as a **whole sequence** to a holomorphic limit `F_∞`, pinned on the real axis by D2.3c. `frequently_ofReal_Ioo_nhdsNE` (the real segment `↑(Ioo 0 T)` accumulates at `↑(T/2)` along `𝓝[≠]`, witnessed by `t0 + δ/(n+2)`), `cubicMayerClusterFreeEnergyComplex_subseq_limit_analyticOnNhd` (any locally-uniform subsequential limit is `AnalyticOnNhd ℂ`, via `vitali_bridge`), `cubicMayerClusterFreeEnergyComplex_subseq_limit_realAxis` (any subsequential limit `= ↑(f_∞ t)` on `Ioo 0 T`, from D2.3c + `tendsto_nhds_unique`). **Headline** `exists_cubicMayerClusterFreeEnergyComplex_limit` (`0 < R`, `0 < T ≤ R`, `T ≤ 1`, per-site KP at `2d`/`R` and `2d`/`T`): `∃ F_∞, DifferentiableOn ℂ F_∞ (ball 0 R) ∧ TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (cubicMayerClusterFreeEnergyComplex d ·) F_∞ atTop (ball 0 R) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, F_∞ ↑t = ↑(cubicInfiniteClusterFreeEnergyReal d t)`. The whole-sequence convergence uses `IsCompact.tendsto_nhds_of_unique_mapClusterPt`: any cluster point of `(Fc n)` in the compact carrier is a holomorphic subsequential limit (L1) agreeing with `↑(f_∞)` on the real segment (L2), so by the identity theorem (`AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq` + `Metric.isPreconnected_ball` + L0) all cluster points coincide — a unique cluster point ⟹ convergence, transported from compact-open to locally uniform via `continuousMap_tendsto_compactOpen_to_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn`. The holomorphic infinite-volume cluster free energy on the high-temperature disc — the analytic object for the §18.6 coupling-analyticity capstone (D2.4). Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.5–§18.6, pp. 335–340; Friedli–Velenik §5.4. |
| §18.6 | **Infinite-volume free-energy coupling analyticity** (Issue #4149, **CAPSTONE**) | **Done (PR-D2.4: `AnalyticAt ℝ (β' ↦ freeEnergyInfinite … ⟨J,0,β'⟩) β` at high temperature)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerCore/CubicMayerCouplingAnalyticity.lean`. **The GJ §18.6 capstone (Issue #4149): the infinite-volume ℤ^d Ising free-energy density is real-analytic in the coupling at high temperature**, realised via the cluster expansion. **Scaling** `freeEnergyInfinite_scaling` (general `G`, `Λ`): `freeEnergyInfinite G Λ ⟨J,0,β⟩ = freeEnergyInfinite G Λ ⟨β·J, 0, 1⟩` — at zero field the Boltzmann weight depends only on `β·J` (`boltzmannWeight_scaling`: `exp(-β·(-J·∑edgeSpin)) = exp(-1·(-(βJ)·∑edgeSpin))`, by `interactionEnergy` linearity + `externalFieldEnergy 0 = 0`), lifted through `partitionFunction`/`freeEnergyΛ`/`freeEnergyAlongExhaustion` to the `limsup`. **Bridge** `..._eq_cluster_of_tanh`: `freeEnergyInfinite ⟨c,0,1⟩ = log 2 + d·log cosh(c) + cubicInfiniteClusterFreeEnergyReal d (tanh c)` (via `Real.artanh_tanh`). **Real-analyticity** `cubicInfiniteClusterFreeEnergyReal_analyticOnNhd`: `AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (cubicInfiniteClusterFreeEnergyReal d) (Ioo 0 T)` (the holomorphic `F_∞` of #4159 restricted to the real axis via `AnalyticOnNhd.re_ofReal` + `.congr`). **Headline** `freeEnergyInfinite_latticeGraph_cubicExhaustion_analyticAt_beta_h_zero` (`0 < βJ`, `tanh βJ < T`, per-site KP at `2d`/`R`,`2d`/`T`, `0 < T ≤ R`, `T ≤ 1`): `AnalyticAt ℝ (fun β' => freeEnergyInfinite (latticeGraph d) (cubicExhaustion d) ⟨J,0,β'⟩) β`, by composing the scaling + bridge with `analyticAt_real_tanh`, `Real.analyticAt_cosh`, `AnalyticAt.log` (`Real.cosh_pos`), `AnalyticAt.comp`, and `cubicInfiniteClusterFreeEnergyReal_analyticOnNhd` at `tanh βJ ∈ Ioo 0 T`; a `J = 1` wrapper `..._analyticAt_beta_unitCoupling`. This is the **§18.6 zero-field, high-temperature, cubic-exhaustion infinite-volume coupling-analyticity capstone** — the endpoint of the cluster-expansion chain (the volume-uniform per-site-KP Mayer identity #4150-4152 → free-energy bounds #4153/#4155 → infinite-volume real-axis bound #4154 → the Montel/Vitali holomorphic limit #4156-4159 → this analyticity capstone). Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.6, pp. 335ff.; Friedli–Velenik §5.4, §5.7. |
| §18.5 | **KP per-site Mayer bound on the ambient lattice (`ℤ^d`-uniform)** (Issue #3954) | **Done (induced-Λ / along-exhaustion / `ℤ^d` wrappers + degree-uniform constant)** | `ClusterExpansion/MayerTsumPerSiteAmbient.lean`. Lifts the abstract volume-uniform per-site Mayer bound (#4137) to the ambient-lattice induced-graph setting and specialises it to `ℤ^d` with a degree-uniform constant. `kpBound Δ t := ((1 − r)(1 − 4r/(1−r)²))⁻¹` (`r = Δ²·e|t|`). `induced_latticeGraph_maxDegree_le d Λ : (inducedGraph (latticeGraph d) Λ).maxDegree ≤ 2d` (via `inducedLatticeGraph_degree_le` + `maxDegree_le_of_forall_degree_le`). `induced_kp_tsum_per_site_le` / `induced_kp_tsum_per_site_alongExhaustion_le` instantiate #4137 on `inducedGraph G Λ` / `inducedGraph G (Λ.volume n)` (general ambient `V`). The KP constant is **monotone in the degree**: `ratio_mono` (`4r/(1−r)²` increasing in `r`), `kpRegion_downward_closed` (the KP region `r < 1 ∧ 4r/(1−r)² < 1` is downward-closed in `r`), `kpBound_r_mono_of_le` (the per-site constant increasing in `r`, via `inv_anti₀` on the decreasing positive product), and `kpBound_mono_of_degree_le`. **Headline** `latticeGraph_kp_tsum_per_site_le` (`Δ²e|t| < 1`, `4r/(1−r)² < 1` stated at `Δ = 2d`): `(∑'_n |mayerExpansionTerm (inducedGraph (latticeGraph d) Λ) (n+1) t|)/|Λ| ≤ kpBound (2d) t` — a per-site Mayer bound **independent of the box `Λ`** (the actual `maxDegree ≤ 2d` discharges the KP hypotheses by downward-closure, then the degree-monotone constant dominates by `kpBound (2d) t`); and `latticeGraph_kp_tsum_per_site_cubicExhaustion_le` gives the same bound uniform over all stages of `cubicExhaustion d`. This closes the §18.5 "Λ-layer + ℤ^d wrappers" tracking item and supplies the volume-uniform analytic input for §18.6. Reference: Glimm–Jaffe, 2nd ed., §18.4–§18.5, pp. 332–336; Friedli–Velenik §5.4 (Theorem 5.4). |

   (`prop_5_4_2_along_exhaustion`, PR #202) and the `limsup`

4. **§5.1 cluster property** at large separation for pure phases — conditional form `clusterProperty_latticeGraph_of_polynomialDecay` (Step 140, PR #958): holds under `HasPolynomialDecay`. Unconditional form (in all pure phases regardless of temperature) would require establishing polynomial decay from first principles.
5. **§17.5 correlation length continuity** and **§17.8 anomalous
   dimension continuity** — require spectral theory of the transfer
   matrix. The fixed-width `K2`/two-site strip case is unconditional
   (`TwoSiteInteractingOpenStripDecay.lean`, PRs #4061-#4064,
   #4142-#4147); the `d ≥ 2` transverse-volume-uniform spectral
   gap that the general continuity would need is **not reachable by the
   global Doob/Dobrushin/Hilbert-diameter route**: PR #4081 shows the
   cross-ratio is site-additive, so that route drives the Dobrushin
   coefficient `δ → 1` with the transverse volume; a uniform estimate
   would have to exploit the site-tensorized structure instead.
6. *(Resolved.)* **Chapter 18** cluster expansion machinery: the Mayer
   expansion identity, per-site Kotecký-Preiss convergence at small
   `tanh(βJ)`, and the resulting infinite-volume free-energy/coupling
   analyticity are formalized — see the §18.4–§18.6 rows above
   (Issues #3954, #4149; KP ingredients and Mayer-series convergence
   in PRs #4085–#4148, coupling analyticity in #4150–#4160).
7. **§20.8 3D Ising roughening** — specialized interface analysis.
